title: Essential final answers
description: Essential Criteria: Student must provide the three angular velocities in correct symbolic form: ω₁ = √(μg/(2r)), ω₂ = √(3μg/(5r)), ω₃ = √(μg/r).

title: Centripetal force identification
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly identify that each mass requires centripetal force F_c = mω²r, with proper radii (r for A and B, 2r for C).

title: Friction force limits
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly state maximum static friction forces: f_max,A = 2μmg, f_max,B = μmg, f_max,C = 2μmg.

title: Tension onset condition
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that tension appears when required centripetal force exceeds available friction, starting with outermost mass C.

title: Force balance equations
description: Important Criteria: Student must set up correct Newton's second law equations for each scenario, accounting for tensions and friction directions.

title: System analysis for ω₃
description: Important Criteria: Student must analyze the entire system to find when friction on A vanishes, considering tensions and other friction forces.

title: Radius confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student uses incorrect radius for any mass (especially using r instead of 2r for C).

title: Mass confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student uses incorrect mass values in friction or centripetal force calculations.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student misassigns direction of friction forces or tensions in equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Student may verify dimensional consistency of final expressions (√(μg/r) has correct angular velocity units).
